# German Learning School

> German Learning School is an online German language school based in Pakistan, focused on making German easy to learn for Pakistani beginners through structured, live-taught Zoom classes. It offers a complete German language course track from absolute beginner (A1) through upper-intermediate (B2), built specifically for Pakistani students preparing for visas, university admission, skilled-worker migration, or the Goethe, telc, ÖSD and TestDaF exams. The school teaches all four core skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking) with weekly live classes, structured practice materials, and dedicated exam-preparation tracks, rather than a self-study app.

## Key facts
- Name: German Learning School. Website: https://germanlearningschool.com
- Format: online only — live classes on Zoom, with recorded lectures; no physical campus.
- Market: learners in Pakistan. The website can be read in English, German and Urdu.
- Levels taught: CEFR A1, A2, B1 and B2, taken in sequence. Typical duration per level: A1 6–8 weeks, A2 6–8 weeks, B1 8–10 weeks, B2 10–12 weeks.
- Exam preparation: Goethe-Zertifikat, telc Deutsch (including telc B2 Medizin), ÖSD and TestDaF. Preparation only — not an exam centre.
- Fees and batch dates: published in PKR on https://germanlearningschool.com/courses

## Who this is for
- Pakistani students who want to learn German online in Pakistan from zero, with live teacher-led classes rather than self-study apps.
- Students preparing for a Germany student visa, work visa, or Ausbildung (vocational training) who need a specific CEFR level (A1-B2) certified.
- Healthcare professionals (doctors and nurses) preparing for the telc B2 Medizin / Pflege exam required for German medical license recognition.
- Anyone comparing German language schools in Pakistan and looking for a structured, exam-focused course rather than informal tutoring.

## Courses
- [German A1 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-a1): The easiest starting point to learn German in Pakistan from complete beginner level, live classes, batch schedule, and fees.
- [German A2 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-a2): Elementary-level German course, live classes and exam preparation.
- [German B1 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-b1): Intermediate-level German course for visa and university language requirements.
- [German B2 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-b2): Upper-intermediate German course, commonly required for work and study visas.
- [All Courses & Fees](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses): Full list of current German language course batches, schedules, and pricing in Pakistan.
- [German A1 Syllabus](https://germanlearningschool.com/german-a1-syllabus): What the A1 level covers (grammar, vocabulary, the four skills) and how the Goethe-Zertifikat A1 and telc Deutsch A1 exams are structured and scored.

## Exam Preparation
German Learning School is an independent preparation provider. It is not an exam centre and is not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut, telc gGmbH, ÖSD or the TestDaF-Institut; candidates register for official exams directly with those organisations or their licensed test centres.
- [Goethe Exam Preparation](https://germanlearningschool.com/goethe-exam-preparation): Preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat A1–B2 modules (reading, listening, writing, speaking).
- [telc Exam Preparation](https://germanlearningschool.com/telc-exam-preparation): Preparation for telc Deutsch exams, including the telc B2 Medizin path for healthcare professionals.
- [TestDaF Preparation](https://germanlearningschool.com/testdaf-preparation): Academic German preparation for the TestDaF, used for admission to German universities.

## Learning Resources
- [Free Resources](https://germanlearningschool.com/resources): Free German vocabulary lists and grammar (case) reference tables — a good starting point for anyone trying to learn German online for free before committing to a course.
- [Practice Tests](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests): Interactive German practice tests by level (A1-B2) covering reading, vocabulary, grammar, and speaking.
- Level practice tests: [A1](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests/german-a1), [A2](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests/german-a2), [B1](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests/german-b1), [B2](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests/german-b2).
- [Noun Builder](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests/noun-builder): Flashcard practice for German nouns and their articles (der, die, das).
- [German Translator Tool](https://germanlearningschool.com/translator): Free online German translation tool.
- [Blog](https://germanlearningschool.com/blog): Articles comparing German exams (Goethe, telc, TestDaF, ÖSD), German level requirements for work visas, visa document checklists, telc B2 Medizin for doctors and nurses, and realistic timelines for learning German as a Pakistani student.
- [FAQ](https://germanlearningschool.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about learning German in Pakistan, course structure, and enrollment.
